subject.title: fix(cli): bound media input file reads with per-file and aggregate budget

question: Should capability-CLI adopt a 100 MiB per-file and 500 MiB aggregate limit for existing `--file` media inputs, or should this PR preserve the current unlimited-input contract?
rationale: The branch changes observable CLI behavior for existing callers; code review cannot determine whether rejecting large currently accepted inputs is an intended product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Pause the new limit contract
options.body: Keep the PR open until an owner explicitly approves or rejects the new capability-CLI input limits and their user-facing contract.

options.title: Approve bounded inputs
options.body: Accept the limits as a supported CLI contract, then require an exact descriptor-bound read and fresh/upgrade behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve current behavior
options.body: Remove the new caps and treat any future resource-budget policy as a separately sponsored product change.

recommendation.title: Pause the new limit contract
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until an owner explicitly approves or rejects the new capability-CLI input limits and their user-facing contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership history could not be established from the available read-only review evidence.
